$description: Polinom Design System motion tokens (FND-08). DTCG format. Sidecar to the design system's tokens.json, which has no motion category; the token build merges both. Shared by both themes and modes (spec §2.2: themes differ in colour only). Values moved from the design system README 'Motion' guidance, 5 Nov 2026.

medium.$description: Small enter/exit: Menu, Popover, Tooltip, Toast.

enter.$description: Ease out. Elements entering or expanding.

exit.$description: Ease in. Elements leaving or collapsing.

reduced.$description: Behaviour under prefers-reduced-motion (Web), MediaQuery.disableAnimations (Flutter), accessibilityReduceMotion (SwiftUI), animator duration scale 0 / reduce-motion setting (Compose). Not a value token; each platform applies the rule in its motion helper.
